title: EventEnvelope
description: Standard wire envelope every RabbitMQ message uses, regardless of exchange or producer. `data` is described per event type by the sibling schema files in this folder.

id.description: Unique id for this event instance.

type.description: Event type, e.g. 'appointment.requested'. Matches the routing key used to publish it.

source.description: Logical name of the service that published the event, e.g. 'api-service', 'ai-service'.

version.description: Envelope/schema version for this event type, e.g. '1.0'.

time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the event occurred.

correlationId.description: Ties this event back to the request or event chain that caused it.

data.description: Event-specific payload - IDs and safe summary data only, never secrets or full private records.
